Builds a Contribution. Needs at least one element and one placement.

    • wrapAfter

      public Contribution.Builder wrapAfter(ModeScope scope, int n)
      In scope, at most n shown contributions in the panel's column, with however many are installed and shown: past that the lowest orders step out into a column to the right, and the highest keep the first, in order (7.5.0). In a row panel it is at most n in a row, the highest orders wrapping onto the next. Beside the creative armor, wrapAfter(ModeScope.CREATIVE, 2) keeps elytra and totem as the column with the ender chest (order 0) beside the elytra, and with two installed it is one column, as in survival. Part of the declaration; once per scope. See Flow.Builder.wrapAfter and Flow.Builder.keepLast().
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when scope already has a cap
